published_prior_art.cite: GabrielSachsSjolander2025Coarsening supplies the ternary boundary; SongGuoChanRichardson2026CategoricalIV supplies arbitrary-support full-exclusion characterization and generic optimization, not the selected-trust envelope.

BalkePearl1997ImperfectCompliance gives the binary eight-piece envelope; GabrielSachsSjolander2025Coarsening gives the ternary full-trust boundary; SongGuoChanRichardson2026CategoricalIV covers the full-trust arbitrary-support model.

GabrielSachsSjolander2025Coarsening establishes that ternary full-trust bounds can be narrower than the binary envelope, but does not supply this positive-cell, perturbation-stable selected-trust/full-exclusion separation.

SongGuoChanRichardson2026CategoricalIV Theorem 4 gives simultaneous finite-sample coverage through a KL-constrained convex program for globally valid IV models; this is a direct affine-face Hoeffding band for the new selected-trust envelope.

FangSantos2019Directional gives directional-derivative resampling under its framework, but not the proposed uniform boundary-cell/vanishing-variance splice with a regular-class strict-width comparison.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives sharp nonparametric ATE bounds for the binary-instrument, binary-treatment, binary-outcome imperfect-compliance model as affine envelopes.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2401.17735v1; corroborating accessible version of Biostatistics 26(1):kxae042
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives ternary coarsening/mixed-validity formulas, shows the two-target/one-ill-defining-level case reduces to the classical first eight pieces, and identifies extension of the higher-level pattern as ongoing research.

The paper characterizes globally valid finite categorical-IV models, obtains sharp linear-functional bounds through optimization, and gives simultaneous finite-sample confidence intervals through a KL-constrained program.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics 32(2), 2023
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops primal-dual symbolic-bound methods, including conditions under which symbolic linear-program bounds are valid and tight.

source_verification_receipts.version: Proceedings of the 41st UAI, PMLR 286, 2025 final published version
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1--2 and Proposition 7 / surrounding observed-IV-model characterization
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves sharpness of the observed instrumental inequalities when instrument and outcome are binary and treatment has arbitrary finite support.

The paper establishes directional-derivative inference and an alternative resampling scheme for directionally differentiable maps, while documenting failure of ordinary bootstrap under nondifferentiability.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a short root proposition proving global-exclusion compatibility is contained in selected-trust compatibility, with the existing pSep family proving strictness; this makes the wider-regime comparison explicit rather than distributed across prose and the separation theorem.

Give a compact worked four- or five-category numerical example in the paper showing the active baseline face, one trusted-nuisance face, and the constructed endpoint response laws; it will make the linear-size formula auditable beyond the ternary reduction.

For the Gaussian Outlook, state an explicit candidate near-active-set threshold sequence and multiplier calibration before attempting uniform validity, so the open question has a falsifiable method specification and a direct comparison to Fang--Santos-type derivative estimation.

recommended_next_step: Advance the sharp-envelope, separation, and finite-sample targets to Stage 0; retain the Gaussian construction as a clearly labeled open statistical rung.
